fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: redfish strong, snook (C&R), Spanish mackerel, pompano, jacks, trout early/late (Blind/Stump Pass, Caspersen, beaches). LEMON BAY: redfish schools, mangrove snapper, snook into ICW. NEARSHORE: red/gag grouper, snapper 95-150ft. Baits: shrimp, soft plastics, live bait, pompano jigs.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no effects, no fish kills or respiratory irritation.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (latest ~10 CFU/100mL enterococci).
